parameters.description: The product's ID, a number such as 692730761, from the trigger or another Ecwid step.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: What the product is called. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Its price, such as 12.50, in the store's currency. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: price

parameters.description: A new SKU. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: sku

parameters.description: What it is. HTML such as bold is kept. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Set the stock to this many, which turns on stock tracking. To add or take away, use 'Adjust product stock'.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: Track this product's stock, or make it unlimited. Leave blank to keep it as it is.
parameters.name: stock_tracking

parameters.description: Ecwid emails the store when stock falls to this many. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: low_stock_level

parameters.description: The price before the sale, shown struck through. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: compare_to_price

parameters.description: Its weight, in the store's weight unit. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: weight

parameters.description: The categories it's in. Replaces its categories; leave blank to keep them.
parameters.name: category_ids

parameters.description: Whether it shows in the store. Leave blank to keep it.
parameters.name: visibility

compare_to_price.description: The price before the sale, shown struck through; empty if none

enabled.description: Whether it shows in the store

in_stock.description: Whether it, or one of its variations, is in stock

low_stock_level.description: The stock level that counts as low; empty if not set

price.description: Its price, before options and taxes

quantity.description: How many are in stock; empty when stock is unlimited

weight.description: Its weight; empty if not set

description: Run your Ecwid store from workflows: find and record orders, mark them paid or shipped, keep products, stock, customers, categories and discount coupons up to date. Start a workflow when an order is placed, paid or shipped, a customer signs up, stock runs low, a cart is abandoned or a review comes in.

ecwid_customer_deleted_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is deleted from the store, with their ID and when it happened.

output.id: The ID of what was deleted

ecwid_customer_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a customer is added or their details change, such as their address or group: once for each change. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.billing_address: Their billing name, address and phone
output.group_id: Their customer group's ID; 0 for General
output.name: Their full name
output.private_notes: The store's private notes on them
output.registered_at: When they registered or first ordered (ISO 8601)

ecwid_new_abandoned_cart_trigger.description: Runs when a shopper leaves items in their cart without finishing checkout, with their email and what's in the cart. Carts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.customer_id: The customer's ID; 0 for a guest
output.customer_name: The customer's name, from the billing address

ecwid_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs when a customer registers or places their first order, with their email, address and group. Customers already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.billing_address: Their billing name, address and phone
output.group_id: Their customer group's ID; 0 for General
output.name: Their full name
output.private_notes: The store's private notes on them
output.registered_at: When they registered or first ordered (ISO 8601)

ecwid_new_order_trigger.description: Runs when an order is placed in the Ecwid store, at checkout, in the admin or by another app, with its items, totals and addresses. Orders already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.coupon_code: The discount coupon used; empty if none
output.coupon_discount: What the discount coupon took off
output.customer_id: The customer's ID; 0 for a guest
output.customer_name: The customer's name, from the billing address
output.discount: The discount Ecwid records on the order, from promotions
output.fulfillment_status: Its fulfillment status, such as SHIPPED
output.id: The order's ID, as customers see it, such as XJ12H
output.internal_id: Ecwid's internal number for the order
output.payment_method: The payment method chosen at checkout
output.payment_status: Its payment status, such as PAID
output.private_notes: The store's private notes on the order
output.shipping_method: The shipping option chosen at checkout
output.subtotal: The cost of the items, before anything else
output.total: The order total, with shipping, taxes and discounts

ecwid_new_product_review_trigger.description: Runs when a customer reviews a product, with the rating, the review and who wrote it. Needs the read_reviews access scope on the custom app.

ecwid_new_product_trigger.description: Runs when a product is added to the catalog, with its price, stock and categories. Products already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.compare_to_price: The price before the sale, shown struck through; empty if none
output.enabled: Whether it shows in the store
output.in_stock: Whether it, or one of its variations, is in stock
output.low_stock_level: The stock level that counts as low; empty if not set
output.name: Its name
output.price: Its price, before options and taxes
output.quantity: How many are in stock; empty when stock is unlimited
output.weight: Its weight; empty if not set

output.quantity: How many are in stock; empty when stock is unlimited
output.weight: Its weight; empty if not set
